annotations.title: Screen a Name Against Sanctions & Watchlists

description: Screen one person or organisation name, including aliases, against sanctions lists (US, EU, UK, UN, Canada, Australia and national lists aggregated by OpenSanctions), politically exposed persons, wanted persons (incl. Interpol Red Notices), development-bank and US debarments, crypto-linked entities, ransomware groups and OFAC-listed vessels. Use it for a quick list check of a name; use run_due_diligence for a scored profile with country and Mauritius registry context, search_mauritius_registry for Mauritius licences, offshore records and local PEPs, and screen_wallet for blockchain addresses. Matching is case-insensitive substring: each hit is labelled exact or partial, and partial hits need human review. The result states when each list was last updated (lists_as_of). Costs $0.002 USDC per successful call via x402 on Base; unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired result and failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: Maximum hits to return, 1-25 (default 10). When the limit is reached the result has truncated=true.

list.description: Search one list group only (default all); mauritius searches the Mauritius registry name index

name.description: Full name to screen, 2-200 characters: letters, digits, spaces and - ' . , ( ) & (e.g. "Lazarus Group"). Longer, more specific names give fewer partial matches.

name: screen_entity

exact_hits.description: Hits whose name equals the query (case/space-insensitive)

hit.description: True when at least one name matched

lists_as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) each screening list was last updated, keyed by list (e.g. us_ofac_sdn, eu_consolidated); check it before relying on a clear result

recommendation.description: REVIEW_REQUIRED when anything matched, otherwise PROCEED

results.description: Matches: name, entity_type (list), entity_id, name_type, is_primary, match_type exact|partial

total_hits.description: Number of matching watchlist names returned

truncated.description: True when `limit` was reached and more matches may exist

anyOf.description: Returned with isError=true when payment is needed: sign one of `accepts` with an x402 client and repeat the call with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

accepts.description: Accepted payment options: scheme 'exact', network 'eip155:8453' (Base), USDC asset, amount in 6-decimal atomic units, payTo address

error.description: Why payment is required, or why the submitted payment was rejected

extensions.description: x402 protocol extensions (e.g. bazaar discovery metadata)

resource.description: The paid resource: url, description, mimeType

anyOf.title: x402 PaymentRequired

title: Screen a Name Against Sanctions & Watchlists
